title: Saving items, weapons, and armor for later. (MV)

posts.author: RPGking7
posts.body:
The idea is to have the player's character change for a time. Naturally they shouldn't have the same items anymore but
I don't want the player to lose all their loot when they return to being there original character. So how do I store item's
of all types for later? I'm sure this has been done before in an RPG Maker game. Also, I do want the player to keep XP and levels, but I think the game remembers that by default.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Well, on a base rpg maker level you'd have to use a control variable command for every possible item the player could potentially have at the point of character change.
After they change back to the original character, you can then use the change item command:
I'm sure there are less frustrating methods you can use via script calls, but I have no idea about those, so this is how it would work with basic event commands.
